items.title: Northern Warren County Transpiration Plan
items.summary: Warren County, the Miami Valley Regional Planning Commission, and the Ohio-Kentucky-Indiana Regional Council of Governments are developing the North Warren County Transportation Plan. Wayne Township is sharing this information to help residents stay informed and participate in the planning process. This is a multiphase study focused on long-term transportation planning across northern Warren…
